blocker.reason: The Qwen3 source-order candidate is visible in receipts, but the generation selector still declines all calls and preserves eager_f32_candle. The committed q_proj trace captures the post-linear eager q_proj output boundary; it does not capture the pre-linear hidden-state input slice bound to the source-order prototype, nor a source-order candidate output vector attributable to generation-time execution.

gaps.name: payload_order
gaps.detail: GGUF Q8_0 payload bytes are source row-major for shape [1024, 2048], while Candle linear runtime expects [2048, 1024]. Pure byte transpose is not accepted because Q8_0 scale blocks would be regrouped.

gaps.name: matrix_shape
gaps.detail: The accepted source-order prototype dimensions are input_dim=1024 and output_dim=2048 for the exact Qwen3 layer-0 q_proj tensor.

gaps.name: tensor_api
gaps.detail: The runtime selector receives a Candle Tensor and can materialize input for the native packed sidecar path only after runtime_compute_enabled passes; there is no source-order branch that binds the exact f32 input slice to the source-order prototype while preserving receipt attribution.

gaps.name: trace_attribution
gaps.detail: The current q_proj trace event records attention.q_proj_output_pre_optional_qnorm after the eager Candle linear path. It cannot prove a source-order q_proj runtime output because selector_selected_calls and packed_matvec_calls are both zero.

gaps.name: lifetime
gaps.detail: The source-order prototype can compare payload math against an eager source-order f32 reference, but no receipt-safe generation-time artifact carries both the runtime input vector and the candidate output vector for the exact warm-session prompt.

blocker.next_safe_step: Add a default-disabled Qwen3 source-order q_proj input/candidate-output capture surface or selector branch that consumes the exact generation-time hidden-state input, emits a source-order candidate vector, and compares it against the eager q_proj warm-session oracle before any runtime selection or performance claim.
